{% include cheatsheet-header.html %}

Sysmon (Sysinternals, v15.x, schema 4.90) writes to `Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational`. Install with a configuration (`sysmon64 -accepteula -i config.xml`), update with `-c config.xml`, and start from a maintained template rather than a blank file; see [Labs]({{ site.baseurl }}/labs/) for a lab build. Event numbers are stable across versions; what changes is the schema and the filterable fields.

## Events

| ID | Event | Key fields | Volume | Techniques | Watch for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | ProcessCreate | `Image`, `CommandLine`, `ParentImage`, `ParentCommandLine`, `User`, `ParentUser`, `IntegrityLevel`, `Hashes`, `OriginalFileName`, `CurrentDirectory`, `ProcessGuid`, `ParentProcessGuid`, `LogonGuid` | High | T1059, T1218, T1036, T1053 | Rare parent/child pairs, `OriginalFileName` not matching `Image`, Medium parent with High child, interpreters spawned by Office or browsers |
| **2** | FileCreateTime | `TargetFilename`, `CreationUtcTime`, `PreviousCreationUtcTime`, `Image` | Low | T1070.006 | Executables or scripts whose creation time is moved back; ignore browsers and installers |
| **3** | NetworkConnect | `Image`, `DestinationIp`, `DestinationHostname`, `DestinationPort`, `SourcePort`, `Initiated`, `Protocol`, `User` | Very high | T1071, T1021, T1048, T1095 | Process-attributed beacons, `rundll32`/`mshta`/`regsvr32` with outbound connections, servers initiating to the internet |
| **4** | Sysmon service state changed | `State`, `Version`, `SchemaVersion` | Low | T1562.001 | Any `Stopped` outside patching: tamper |
| **5** | ProcessTerminate | `Image`, `ProcessGuid` | High | T1059 | Lifetime of short-lived tools when joined to event 1 |
| **6** | DriverLoad | `ImageLoaded`, `Hashes`, `Signed`, `Signature`, `SignatureStatus` | Low | T1068, T1014, T1562.001 | Unsigned or expired-cert drivers, known vulnerable drivers (BYOVD: loldrivers.io hashes), drivers from `C:\Users` or `C:\Windows\Temp` |
| **7** | ImageLoad | `Image`, `ImageLoaded`, `Signed`, `SignatureStatus`, `OriginalFileName`, `Hashes` | Very high (filter) | T1574.001/.002, T1055, T1003 | Unsigned DLLs loaded from user-writable paths, system DLL names loaded from the wrong path, `samlib.dll`/`vaultcli.dll`/`winscard.dll` in odd processes, `clr.dll` in `rundll32`/`mshta` |
| **8** | CreateRemoteThread | `SourceImage`, `TargetImage`, `StartAddress`, `StartModule`, `StartFunction` | Low | T1055.001/.003 | Source not in a known injector allow-list, `StartModule` empty, target is `lsass.exe`, `explorer.exe` or a browser |
| **9** | RawAccessRead | `Image`, `Device` | Low | T1003.003, T1006 | Reads of `\Device\HarddiskVolume*` by anything but backup, AV or `vssvc.exe`: NTDS.dit and SAM theft |
| **10** | ProcessAccess | `SourceImage`, `TargetImage`, `GrantedAccess`, `CallTrace`, `SourceUser`, `TargetUser` | High (filter) | T1003.001, T1055 | Access to `lsass.exe` with credential-dump masks (below), `CallTrace` with `UNKNOWN` frames, access from `C:\Users` |
| **11** | FileCreate | `TargetFilename`, `Image`, `CreationUtcTime`, `User` | High (filter) | T1105, T1074, T1547.001, T1486 | Executables and scripts in `Temp`, `Public`, `ProgramData`, `Startup`; ransom notes; `.lnk`/`.iso`/`.img` from mail and browsers |
| **12** | RegistryEvent (object create / delete) | `EventType`, `TargetObject`, `Image` | High (filter) | T1547, T1546, T1112 | New keys under `Run`, `Services`, `Winlogon`, `Image File Execution Options`, CLSID `InprocServer32` |
| **13** | RegistryEvent (value set) | `EventType`, `TargetObject`, `Details`, `Image` | High (filter) | T1547.001, T1546.015, T1562.001, T1112 | `Details` pointing at user paths or script hosts, Defender `Exclusions`, `DisableAntiSpyware`, `EnableLUA`, `LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy`, `ms-settings` shell handlers (UAC bypass) |
| **14** | RegistryEvent (key and value rename) | `EventType`, `TargetObject`, `NewName` | Low | T1112 | Renames that hide persistence |
| **15** | FileCreateStreamHash | `TargetFilename`, `Contents`, `Hash`, `Image` | Medium | T1564.004, T1553.005 | `Zone.Identifier` with `HostUrl` (download origin for free), payloads hidden in ADS |
| **16** | ServiceConfigurationChange (Sysmon config) | `Configuration`, `ConfigurationFileHash` | Low | T1562.001 | Any config change not matching your deployment hash |
| **17** | PipeEvent (pipe created) | `PipeName`, `Image`, `User` | Medium | T1021.002, T1071, T1055 | C2 pipe names (`\msagent_*`, `\MSSE-*-server`, `\postex_*`, `\mojo.*` lookalikes), `\PSEXESVC`, `\paexec*`, `\csexec*`, `\atsvc`/`\srvsvc` from non-system images |
| **18** | PipeEvent (pipe connected) | `PipeName`, `Image` | Medium | T1021.002, T1055 | Clients of the pipes above; `\lsass`/`\samr`/`\winreg` connections from unexpected images |
| **19** | WmiEvent (filter activity) | `Operation`, `User`, `EventNamespace`, `Name`, `Query` | Low | T1546.003 | `__EventFilter` creation with `Win32_ProcessStartTrace`, `__InstanceModificationEvent` timers |
| **20** | WmiEvent (consumer activity) | `Operation`, `Name`, `Type`, `Destination` | Low | T1546.003 | `CommandLineEventConsumer` / `ActiveScriptEventConsumer`; `Destination` is the payload |
| **21** | WmiEvent (consumer to filter binding) | `Operation`, `Consumer`, `Filter` | Low | T1546.003 | The binding is the persistence; alert on create |
| **22** | DNSEvent | `QueryName`, `QueryStatus`, `QueryResults`, `Image`, `User` | Very high (filter) | T1071.004, T1568, T1048.003 | Process-attributed DNS: long or high-entropy labels, TXT-heavy clients, DGA-like NXDOMAIN bursts, `QueryResults` with `::ffff:` IPv4 mapping |
| **23** | FileDelete (archived) | `TargetFilename`, `Image`, `Hashes`, `IsExecutable`, `Archived` | Medium | T1070.004, T1485 | Deletion of dropped tools; the file is copied to `ArchiveDirectory` for recovery |
| **24** | ClipboardChange | `Image`, `Session`, `ClientInfo`, `Hashes` | Low (opt-in) | T1115 | RDP clipboard use; sensitive, enable with care |
| **25** | ProcessTampering | `Image`, `Type` (`Image is replaced`, `Image is locked for access`) | Low | T1055.012, T1036 | Hollowing, herpaderping, ghosting; filter the known-good ones (browsers, `WerFault`, some installers) |
| **26** | FileDeleteDetected | `TargetFilename`, `Image`, `Hashes`, `IsExecutable` | Medium | T1070.004, T1486 | Same as 23 without the archive copy; mass deletes by one process, shadow-copy-adjacent cleanup |
| **27** | FileBlockExecutable | `TargetFilename`, `Image`, `Hashes` | Low | T1105, T1204 | Blocked PE writes (for example Office or browsers writing `.exe`); the block is the detection |
| **28** | FileBlockShredding | `TargetFilename`, `Image`, `IsExecutable` | Low | T1485 | Blocked overwrite-delete patterns used by shredders and wipers |
| **29** | FileExecutableDetected | `TargetFilename`, `Image`, `Hashes`, `User` | Medium | T1105, T1204.002 | New PE files written anywhere: cheap first-seen inventory of binaries per host |
| **255** | Error | `ID`, `Description` | Low | | Driver or service faults; a burst usually means a config problem or tampering |

## Field conventions that make pivots work

- **`ProcessGuid` / `ParentProcessGuid`**: unique per process instance across reboots; build trees on these, never on PID.
- **`LogonGuid` and `LogonId`**: join to Security 4624 (`TargetLogonId`) to get logon type and source for any process.
- **`OriginalFileName`** comes from the PE version resource and survives renaming; compare with the `Image` basename (`rclone.exe` renamed to `svchost.exe`, `procdump` renamed to `dump.exe`).
- **`Hashes`**: configure `<HashAlgorithms>md5,sha256,IMPHASH</HashAlgorithms>`; IMPHASH clusters recompiled tooling, SHA256 is for prevalence (count of hosts per hash).
- **`User` / `ParentUser` / `SourceUser` / `TargetUser`** (v13+): catches cross-user injection and services spawning user-context children.
- **`IntegrityLevel`**: `Low` (browser sandboxes), `Medium` (users), `High` (elevated), `System`; a High child of a Medium parent without a consent prompt is a UAC bypass lead.
- **`CallTrace`** (event 10): module-by-module stack of the caller; `UNKNOWN(...)` frames mean memory not backed by a file (injected or reflective code), `dbgcore.dll`/`dbghelp.dll` means a minidump API.
- **`GrantedAccess`** (event 10) masks seen against `lsass.exe`: `0x1010` (PROCESS_VM_READ + QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION: Mimikatz-style read), `0x1410`, `0x1438`, `0x143A`, `0x1FFFFF` (PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS: procdump, comsvcs MiniDump), `0x0010` (VM_READ only), `0x0040` (DUP_HANDLE), `0x1F3FFF`; `0x1000` or `0x1400` alone (query only) is usually benign.
- **`RuleName`**: tag every include rule with the technique it serves (`RuleName="technique_id=T1003.001,technique_name=LSASS Memory"`); the tag arrives in the event and makes triage and coverage counting trivial.
- **`QueryStatus`** (event 22): `0` success, `9003` NXDOMAIN (NAME_ERROR), `9501` no records, `1460` timeout; NXDOMAIN bursts per process are the DGA signal.
- **`Zone.Identifier`** (event 15): `Contents` holds `ZoneId=3` plus `HostUrl`/`ReferrerUrl`; the origin of every downloaded file without a proxy log.

## High-value filters (fragments to copy)

Schema 4.90; `onmatch="include"` logs only what matches, `onmatch="exclude"` logs everything except. For event 1 log nearly everything and exclude noise; for 3, 7, 11, 12/13 and 22 use includes.

```xml
<!-- 10: anything touching LSASS with a read or full-access mask -->
<ProcessAccess onmatch="include">
  <Rule groupRelation="and" name="technique_id=T1003.001,technique_name=LSASS Memory">
    <TargetImage condition="is">C:\Windows\system32\lsass.exe</TargetImage>
    <GrantedAccess condition="contains any">0x1010;0x1410;0x1438;0x143A;0x1FFFFF;0x0010;0x1F3FFF</GrantedAccess>
  </Rule>
</ProcessAccess>
<!-- 7: unsigned DLLs from user-writable paths, and classic side-load targets -->
<ImageLoad onmatch="include">
  <Rule groupRelation="and" name="technique_id=T1574.002,technique_name=DLL Side-Loading">
    <ImageLoaded condition="begin with">C:\Users\</ImageLoaded>
    <Signed condition="is">false</Signed>
  </Rule>
  <ImageLoaded condition="end with" name="technique_id=T1574.001">version.dll;wininet.dll;cryptbase.dll;dbghelp.dll;mscoree.dll;userenv.dll;profapi.dll;dwmapi.dll;uxtheme.dll;wtsapi32.dll</ImageLoaded>
  <ImageLoaded condition="end with" name="technique_id=T1003">samlib.dll;vaultcli.dll;winscard.dll;ntdsapi.dll;comsvcs.dll</ImageLoaded>
</ImageLoad>
<!-- 17/18: C2 and remote-execution pipes -->
<PipeEvent onmatch="include">
  <PipeName condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1071,technique_name=C2 named pipes">\msagent_;\MSSE-;\postex_;\status_;\mypipe;\win_svc;\ntsvcs_;\scerpc_;\DserNamePipe;\SearchTextHarvester;\wkssvc_;\spoolss_;\winsock</PipeName>
  <PipeName condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1021.002,technique_name=Remote service execution">\PSEXESVC;\paexec;\csexec;\remcom;\atsvc</PipeName>
</PipeEvent>
<!-- 11: executables and scripts landing in writable and autostart locations -->
<FileCreate onmatch="include">
  <TargetFilename condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1547.001,technique_name=Startup Folder">\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\;\Startup\</TargetFilename>
  <Rule groupRelation="and" name="technique_id=T1105,technique_name=Ingress Tool Transfer">
    <TargetFilename condition="contains any">\AppData\Local\Temp\;\Users\Public\;C:\ProgramData\;C:\Windows\Temp\;\Downloads\</TargetFilename>
    <TargetFilename condition="end with">.exe;.dll;.ps1;.vbs;.js;.hta;.bat;.cmd;.scr;.iso;.img;.lnk;.msi;.cpl</TargetFilename>
  </Rule>
</FileCreate>
<!-- 12/13: persistence and tamper keys -->
<RegistryEvent onmatch="include">
  <TargetObject condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1547.001,technique_name=Registry Run Keys">\CurrentVersion\Run;\CurrentVersion\RunOnce;\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Shell Folders;\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\Shell;\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\Userinit;\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\Notify</TargetObject>
  <TargetObject condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1543.003,technique_name=Windows Service">\Services\;\ImagePath;\ServiceDll</TargetObject>
  <TargetObject condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1546,technique_name=Event Triggered Execution">\Image File Execution Options\;\InprocServer32;\LocalServer32;\ScriptletURL;\TreatAs;\AppCertDlls;\AppInit_DLLs;\SilentProcessExit\;\ms-settings\Shell\Open\command;\mscfile\shell\open\command</TargetObject>
  <TargetObject condition="contains any" name="technique_id=T1562.001,technique_name=Impair Defenses">\Windows Defender\Exclusions\;\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware;\Real-Time Protection\;\Policies\System\EnableLUA;\LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy;\Lsa\RunAsPPL;\DisableRestrictedAdmin;\Terminal Server\fDenyTSConnections</TargetObject>
</RegistryEvent>
<!-- 22: cut the noise, keep the signal -->
<DnsQuery onmatch="exclude">
  <QueryName condition="end with">.microsoft.com;.windowsupdate.com;.office.net;.in-addr.arpa;.local</QueryName>
  <Image condition="is">C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe</Image>
</DnsQuery>
<!-- 27: block (and log) Office and browsers writing executables -->
<FileBlockExecutable onmatch="include">
  <Image condition="end with" name="technique_id=T1204.002,technique_name=Malicious File">\winword.exe;\excel.exe;\powerpnt.exe;\outlook.exe;\msedge.exe;\chrome.exe;\firefox.exe</Image>
</FileBlockExecutable>
```

## Configuration tips

- **Templates**: SwiftOnSecurity `sysmon-config` (one file, conservative, readable), Olaf Hartong `sysmon-modular` (per-technique modules merged by a script, `RuleName` tags included, heavier), Florian Roth's `sysmon-config` fork (adds more evasion coverage). Start with one, diff against the others, keep your own in version control.
- **Include vs exclude**: exclude-based logging for 1 (see everything, trim known-noisy parents such as updaters) and 5; include-based for 3, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 17, 18, 22. Mixing both for one event needs two rule groups; order and `groupRelation` matter.
- **Noise to expect**: 7 and 22 dominate volume; 25 fires for browsers, `WerFault.exe` and some installers; 6 fires at boot for every driver, so filter by `Signed`/`SignatureStatus` rather than dropping it; 3 from `svchost`, Teams and browsers.
- **Event 23 archiving**: `<ArchiveDirectory>Sysmon</ArchiveDirectory>` keeps deleted files under `C:\Sysmon\` (system ACL); set a size limit and a cleanup job, or use 26 instead if storage is tight.
- **Tamper detection**: alert on event 4 (`Stopped`), 16 (config hash change), System 7036 for `Sysmon64` stopping, and on `sysmon64.exe -u`/`-c` in event 1. Rename the service and driver (`-d` at install) to raise the bar.
- **Deployment**: GPO startup script or Intune Win32 app; push config updates with `sysmon64 -c new.xml`; keep the config hash in a registry value or in `RuleName` so you can tell which hosts run which version. Dump the live config with `sysmon64 -c` (no file).
- **Sysmon for Linux** (`sysmonforlinux`): events 1, 3, 5, 9, 10, 11, 16, 23 only; writes XML to syslog (`/var/log/syslog` or journald, facility `local0`), same schema names, no hashes of images by default; useful for `execve` and network attribution where auditd is too raw.
- **Collect it**: WEF subscription or agent on `Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational`; keep XML rendering so field names survive.

## Query examples

Splunk (sourcetype `XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational`, or `sysmon` via the Sysmon add-on; field names match the event fields):

```spl
index=sysmon EventCode=1 | eval parent=lower(ParentImage), child=lower(Image) | stats dc(host) as hosts count values(CommandLine) as cmd by parent child | where hosts<=2
index=sysmon EventCode=1 | eval img=lower(replace(Image,".*\\\\","")) | where OriginalFileName!="" AND lower(OriginalFileName)!=img AND lower(OriginalFileName)!=img+".exe" | stats count by host Image OriginalFileName
index=sysmon EventCode=3 Initiated=true | stats count dc(DestinationIp) as dests by host Image | where dests>50 AND NOT match(Image,"(?i)chrome|msedge|firefox|teams|svchost")
index=sysmon EventCode=7 Signed=false ImageLoaded="C:\\Users\\*" | stats dc(host) as hosts by ImageLoaded Image | sort hosts
index=sysmon EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" GrantedAccess IN ("0x1010","0x1410","0x1438","0x143A","0x1FFFFF") | stats count by host SourceImage GrantedAccess CallTrace
index=sysmon EventCode=11 TargetFilename IN ("*\\Temp\\*.exe","*\\Public\\*.exe","*\\ProgramData\\*.exe","*\\Startup\\*") | stats count by host Image TargetFilename
index=sysmon EventCode=13 TargetObject="*\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" | stats dc(host) as hosts by TargetObject Details | where hosts<=3
index=sysmon EventCode IN (17,18) | stats count dc(host) as hosts by PipeName Image | sort hosts count
index=sysmon EventCode=22 QueryStatus=9003 | stats dc(QueryName) as nx by host Image | where nx>100
index=sysmon EventCode=25 | stats count by host Image Type | where NOT match(Image,"(?i)msedge|chrome|firefox|werfault")
```

Microsoft Sentinel (Sysmon forwarded into the `Event` table; the Sysmon parser or ASIM `imProcessCreate` gives typed columns, otherwise extract from `EventData`):

```kql
Event
| where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 1
| extend d = parse_xml(EventData).DataItem.EventData.Data
| mv-apply d on (summarize b = make_bag(pack(tostring(d["@Name"]), tostring(d["#text"]))))
| extend Image = tostring(b.Image), Parent = tostring(b.ParentImage), Cmd = tostring(b.CommandLine), Orig = tostring(b.OriginalFileName)
| where isnotempty(Orig) and tolower(Orig) != tolower(split(Image, "\\")[-1])
| summarize count(), any(Cmd) by Computer, Image, Orig
```

Defender for Endpoint equivalents when you have EDR instead of (or as well as) Sysmon:

| Sysmon | Defender for Endpoint table | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 / 5 | `DeviceProcessEvents` | `ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName` = `OriginalFileName`, `ProcessIntegrityLevel`, `InitiatingProcess*` = parent |
| 3 | `DeviceNetworkEvents` | `ActionType` `ConnectionSuccess`/`ConnectionFailed`/`InboundConnectionAccepted`; `RemoteUrl` when known |
| 6 / 7 | `DeviceImageLoadEvents` | Drivers and DLLs together; `SHA256`, `FileName`, `FolderPath` |
| 8 / 10 / 25 | `DeviceEvents` | `ActionType` in (`CreateRemoteThreadApiCall`, `OpenProcessApiCall`, `ReadProcessMemoryApiCall`, `NtAllocateVirtualMemoryRemoteApiCall`, `NtMapViewOfSectionRemoteApiCall`, `SetThreadContextRemoteApiCall`, `QueueUserApcRemoteApiCall`); LSASS access is `OpenProcessApiCall` with `FileName == "lsass.exe"` and the mask in `AdditionalFields.DesiredAccess` |
| 11 / 23 / 26 / 29 | `DeviceFileEvents` | `ActionType` `FileCreated`, `FileModified`, `FileDeleted`, `FileRenamed`; `FileOriginUrl`/`FileOriginReferrerUrl` replaces the Zone.Identifier trick |
| 12 / 13 / 14 | `DeviceRegistryEvents` | `ActionType` `RegistryKeyCreated`, `RegistryValueSet`, `RegistryKeyDeleted`; `RegistryValueData` = `Details` |
| 15 | `DeviceFileEvents` | `FileOriginUrl` |
| 17 / 18 | `DeviceEvents` | `ActionType` `NamedPipeEvent`, pipe name in `AdditionalFields` |
| 19 / 20 / 21 | `DeviceEvents` | `ActionType` `WmiBindEventFilterToConsumer` and related |
| 22 | `DeviceNetworkEvents` / `DeviceEvents` | `ActionType` `DnsQueryResponse` (`DeviceEvents`, `AdditionalFields` carries the query and response) |
